tests.case: disposal releases presentation subscriptions while preserving borrowed library %s and feed %s

FullscreenContextLifetimeTests.Disposal_.reason: All three original borrowing combinations run against mounted Electron presentations. Each owned query observer and event/fullscreen subscription detaches; borrowed library/feed observers and snapshots survive and the cache can still refresh. Electron uses shared raw API snapshots plus per-surface view state instead of Avalonia DI model instances.

tests.case: shares persisted appearance and dormancy while keeping fullscreen motion and sizing independent on reentry
imports the original palette once and shares it between desktop and fullscreen
imports the original %s palette through the public Theme preference
persists imported typography and explicit per-palette edits through a runtime restart
keeps desktop and fullscreen journal sections and periods independent over a shared library cache
quick menu and fullscreen browse retain independent desktop filters and refresh behind preparation on return
all original palette changes preserve controller root cycling and loaded shelves at ${width}x${height}
keeps selected lists, live rules and restored sort independent between desktop and fullscreen

FullscreenContextTests.Runtime_factory_i.reason: Equivalent runtime ownership is per-surface Library/list/filter and Journal state over a borrowed QueryClient. Composed and native tests preserve desktop filters, independently selected journal periods/sections, shared persisted theme/dormancy, ignored legacy fullscreen keys, fullscreen-only motion and persisted .7 sizing/ultrawide settings on reentry. All nine palette changes update the backdrop ground/gradient and retain loaded navigation. DOM/CSS token inheritance replaces Avalonia brush-resource objects; frontend appearance profiles preserve user theme edits.

tests.case: hover leaves actions clear while selection stays neutral and focus uses the accent

FullscreenInteractionTests.Hover_does_no.reason: At the original 1920x1080 size, hover remains over Screen margins while controller Down moves focus. Its underline is transparent, selected Appearance retains the neutral token, and the focused action uses the distinct accent token.

tests.case: Details keeps unread badge tab geometry and restores Library backdrop origin at ${width}x${height} text ${scale}

FullscreenInteractionTests.Details_backd.reason: At 1920x1080 and 2560x1440, opening a selected Library game hides root navigation, shows Back to Library, fills the entire viewport with the Details backdrop, and controller Back restores the Library navigation and exact game focus.

tests.case: controller cursor ownership restores the hovered input and releases on fullscreen exit
releases cursor ownership on surface changes and unmount while mouse movement restores it

FullscreenInteractionTests.Controller_hi.reason: Native Electron checks fullscreen cursor ownership, mouse release, exit release and a hovered desktop text-input cursor. Controlled polling also tests both mode transitions and unmount cleanup without leaving a frame loop.

tests.case: ultrawide fit expands and restores content without changing typography

FullscreenInteractionTests.Ultrawide_fit.reason: Replays 2560x1080 and 3440x1440: enabling fit increases the usable content width without changing type at a fixed viewport, resize expands it, and disabling fit restores the reference-aspect bound. Responsive CSS replaces the original .85-scaled Avalonia Viewbox; the geometry invariant is measured in rendered client pixels.

tests.case: minimum 1200x688 fullscreen uses its own search page and bounded controller keyboard

FullscreenInteractionTests.Fullscreen_ho.reason: At the original 1200x688 size, controller View opens the independent fullscreen Search page, desktop chrome is absent, Y opens a fully bounded keyboard, and B closes it and restores the search field.

tests.case: restores native window state maximized ${maximized} and desktop visibility

FullscreenInteractionTests.Fullscreen_re.reason: Real BrowserWindow fullscreen entry preserves normal bounds and restores both original normal and maximized states. F11 and external native fullscreen exit are exercised separately; only the active desktop/fullscreen shell is visible.

tests.case: entry button and F11 toggle before library context is available

FullscreenInteractionTests.Entry_button_.reason: Primary API reads are held before any library context exists. The accessible startup entry button enters native fullscreen, F11 toggles back and in again, and releasing data completes preparation. Electron startup composition owns the entry control; normal desktop already exposes its fullscreen utility.

tests.case: quick menu and fullscreen browse retain independent desktop filters and refresh behind preparation on return

FullscreenInteractionTests.Controller_qu.reason: Desktop search and sort survive fullscreen collection/filter and quick-menu navigation. Returning to fullscreen retains its selected collection while refreshing preparation independently.

tests.case: quick menu and fullscreen browse retain independent desktop filters and refresh behind preparation on return

FullscreenInteractionTests.Returning_to_.reason: Held primary/feed reads on return leave desktop content inert behind Preparing your library. Releasing the real API transport gate reveals the preserved desktop search and sort only after readiness.

tests.case: main pages retain bounded controller focus at reference and smaller sizes with idempotent text scaling

FullscreenInteractionTests.Main_screens_.reason: All four root pages use controller shoulder navigation at 1920x1080 with bounded content-button focus and visible cover outlines. Details and the search keyboard are captured, then Home/Library/Settings are checked at 1280x720. Visible fallback title sizing grows by 1.4, remains within the original 24-34 logical-pixel range after viewport normalization, and repeated updates do not compound. Screenshots accompany the source-sized states.

tests.case: Details keeps unread badge tab geometry and restores Library backdrop origin at ${width}x${height} text ${scale}

FullscreenNavigationLayoutTests.Details_.reason: At the original 2560x1440 and text scales 1/1.4, a real seeded one-unread-update game renders Updates 1 plus its pip; four controller RT changes leave every tab rectangle unchanged. The 1920x1080 source interaction fixture is also covered.

tests.case: local section labels and trigger hints stay stationary and visible at ${width}x${height} text ${scale}

FullscreenNavigationLayoutTests.Selectio.reason: At 2560x1440 and .7/1/1.4 text scales, selection/focus across the production Library, Activity and seven Settings labels (including Metadata & artwork) preserves exact tab/trigger rectangles and bold selected labels. These production strips replace the original synthetic five-label strip, exercising the same width-reservation invariant plus section-specific content changes.

tests.case: repeated controller Menu preserves one menu and exact origin with nested ${nested}

FullscreenQuickMenuTests.Repeated_start_.reason: Root and nested filter-editor origins each run two complete cycles. Five extra Menu presses keep one dialog and its exact focused item. Controller B and controller Resume restore the captured original control. The nested Radix editor exercises the same modal-stack ownership as the source nested game-actions dialog.

tests.case: local section labels and trigger hints stay stationary and visible at ${width}x${height} text ${scale}

FullscreenSectionHintTests.Trigger_hints.reason: Library, Activity and Settings retain two visible, non-focusable LT/RT SVG glyphs outside the scrolling section strip before and after controller RT. Replays the original 1920x1080 1/1.4 matrix and adds 2560x1440 at .7/1/1.4; native bounds and screenshots establish glyph rendering and containment.

tests.case: all original palette changes preserve controller root cycling and loaded shelves at ${width}x${height}

FullscreenThemeNavigationTests.Returning.reason: Replays all nine original palettes at 1280x720 and 3840x2160 with 1.4 text and 2% safe margins. Controller LB enters Settings and RB returns Home after each palette; Right changes the loaded cover focus and Left restores the exact first cover. The backdrop gradient tracks the selected palette ground.
